newsitem.title: USA: Laker accepts mediation with British Air.
newsitem.headline: Laker accepts mediation with British Air.

text.p: Laker Airways Inc has accepted Florida Attorney General Bob Butterworth's offer to mediate the airline's dispute with British Airways Plc, Laker owner Freddie Laker said Wednesday.
British Air has not yet responded to Butterworth's offer, a spokesman for Butterworth said.

Laker, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., sued British Air in federal court in Miami last month, alleging that the British carrier had used its dominant position to prevent Laker from getting desirable takeoff and landing slots at London's Gatwick Airport.
In a letter to both airlines, Butterworth urged the carriers to accept mediation to resolve the dispute quickly.
"We're looking forward to seeing (Butterworth) as soon as possible," Freddie Laker told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"We are probably losing $50,000 worth of business a day because of the times at which we have to operate," he said. "We're being beaten to death."
Laker Air has asked the court to enforce an agreement between the United States and Britain calling for fair and equal opportunity for businesses.
Laker Air's antitrust suit alleges that British Air has used "monopoly power" in the UK "to create obstacles and block opportunities" for Laker Air at Gatwick Airport.
Butterworth said in his letter that if Laker's allegations are true, Florida's tourism-dependent economy could be hurt.
"Any policy that limits the ability of consumers to enjoy a full range of options for their own vacations would be of great concern to this office," he said in the letter.

Butterworth offered to arrange mediation sessions, with Miami attorney Parker Thompson as the mediator. Thompson frequently serves as special counsel to Butterworth's office and has been involved in the state's proposed settlement with the tobacco industry.
Laker Air said Butterworth had set a July 9 deadline for the parties to agree to mediation.
There was no immediate comment from British Airways.
